lines.zh: 我游在冻河底下，冰面透下白蓝的光。
lines.en: I swim under the frozen river, pale blue light seeping through.

lines.zh: 冷得刺骨，可我的鳍是粉的，很显眼。
lines.en: The cold bites, but my pink fins stand out clearly.

lines.zh: 冰块擦过我的背，我偏了一下。
lines.en: A chunk of ice scrapes my back and I veer away.

lines.zh: 河底的石头滑，我贴着游。
lines.en: The riverbed stones are slick, so I swim close to them.

lines.zh: 我们两条一起，穿过冰窟窿。
lines.en: The two of us pass through a hole in the ice.

lines.zh: 水声在冰下闷闷地响。
lines.en: The sound of water is muffled beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 我摆尾慢，粉鳍像水里的一片花瓣。
lines.en: My tail moves slowly; my pink fin looks like a petal.

lines.zh: 越往上游，水越冷，我越舒服。
lines.en: Upstream the water grows colder, and I like it more.

lines.zh: 雪落在冰面上，我听不见。
lines.en: Snow falls on the ice, and I cannot hear it.

lines.zh: 冰缝里透光，我就往那儿游。
lines.en: Light comes through a crack, so I swim toward it.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根倒下的树干。
lines.en: I go around a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 冷河里的鱼不多，我不怕谁。
lines.en: Few fish live in the cold river, and I fear none.

lines.zh: 我的鳍冻不僵，这是天生的。
lines.en: My fins never stiffen in the cold; that is how I am made.

lines.zh: 河岸的雪堆得太高，水都暗了。
lines.en: Snow piles high on the banks and dims the water.

lines.zh: 冰下的水走得很慢，我跟着。
lines.en: Under the ice the water crawls. I match it.

lines.zh: 我贴着河岸的雪壁游。
lines.en: I swim along the snowbank wall.

lines.zh: 我悬在冰下，看冰里的气泡。
lines.en: I hang beneath the ice, watching bubbles trapped inside it.

lines.zh: 冰面很厚，光只剩一点点。
lines.en: The ice is thick and only a little light gets through.

lines.zh: 我的粉鳍在冷水里轻轻摆。
lines.en: My pink fin sways gently in the cold water.

lines.zh: 河底有块石头，我已经看了很久。
lines.en: There is a stone on the riverbed I have watched a long time.

lines.zh: 有片雪落进水里，化了。
lines.en: A flake of snow falls in and melts.

lines.zh: 这里安静得能听见水流转弯。
lines.en: It is so quiet I can hear the current turn.

lines.zh: 我不动，粉鳍也一直亮着。
lines.en: I hold still, and my pink fin keeps glowing.

lines.zh: 冬天很长，我慢慢等。
lines.en: Winter is long; I wait it out slowly.

lines.zh: 冰下的水比岸上暖一点。
lines.en: The water under the ice is warmer than the air.

lines.zh: 一只兔子在冰上跑过，影子扫下来。
lines.en: A rabbit runs over the ice, its shadow sweeping down.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进石缝，找吃的。
lines.en: I push my head into a crevice to look for food.

lines.zh: 冷让我清醒，也让我懒得动。
lines.en: The cold keeps me alert and makes me lazy.

lines.zh: 我的鳍有一处旧伤，天冷会僵。
lines.en: One fin has an old wound that stiffens in cold weather.

lines.zh: 河面结冰时，声音像有人在敲。
lines.en: When the river freezes, it sounds like someone knocking.

lines.zh: 我停在冰洞下，看光落下来。
lines.en: I hold under the ice hole and watch the light fall.

lines.zh: 水草冻住了，我不去碰。
lines.en: The weeds are frozen stiff. I leave them.

lines.zh: 你站在冰上，影子落在我头顶。
lines.en: You stand on the ice and your shadow falls on me.

lines.zh: 你凿开冰洞，我游到边上看看。
lines.en: You cut a hole and I swim over to look.

lines.zh: 你一开口，白气就飘到我头顶的冰上。
lines.en: When you speak, white mist drifts onto the ice above me.

lines.zh: 我隔着冰看你，你的脸是弯的。
lines.en: I see you through the ice, your face bent by it.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我把粉鳍贴在冰面上。
lines.en: You crouch, and I press my pink fin to the ice.

lines.zh: 你手很冷吧，水里更冷。
lines.en: Your hands must be cold; the water is colder.

lines.zh: 我认得出你的靴子，你昨天也来过。
lines.en: I know those boots; you came yesterday too.

lines.zh: 你往水里看，我就往上浮一点。
lines.en: You peer into the water, so I float up a little.

lines.zh: 你的影子惊走了旁边的小鱼。
lines.en: Your shadow scares off the smaller fish nearby.

lines.zh: 你说话时，冰面在震。
lines.en: When you speak, the ice vibrates.

lines.zh: 你想捞我，我退到冰层深处。
lines.en: You want to scoop me up, so I retreat under the ice.

lines.zh: 你走后，冰洞又慢慢冻上了一层。
lines.en: After you leave, the hole slowly skins over with ice.

lines.zh: 粉鳍被划开，血在冷水里拉成线。
lines.en: My pink fin is cut, and blood draws a line in the cold.

lines.zh: 我疼得往冰层最下面钻。
lines.en: The pain drives me to the very bottom under the ice.

lines.zh: 别打，我这点肉不值得。
lines.en: Do not hit me; this little meat is not worth it.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得翻了过来。
lines.en: That blow flips me onto my back.

lines.zh: 冷水让伤口没那么疼，但更僵。
lines.en: The cold dulls the wound but makes it stiffer.

lines.zh: 我的鳍缺了一块，游起来歪。
lines.en: A piece of my fin is gone, and I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 血散得很慢，像一小片粉。
lines.en: The blood spreads slowly, like a small pink patch.

lines.zh: 我沉到石头后面，不再动。
lines.en: I sink behind a stone and stop moving.

lines.zh: 冰下的回声把这一下放大了。
lines.en: The echo under the ice makes that blow sound worse.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就游不动了。
lines.en: One more and I will not be able to swim.

lines.zh: 你把饵放进冰洞，我绕了两圈。
lines.en: You lower bait into the hole, and I circle it twice.

lines.zh: 那股味道在冷水里传得很慢。
lines.en: That smell travels slowly through the cold water.

lines.zh: 我碰了一下饵，又退开。
lines.en: I touch the bait, then pull back.

lines.zh: 冬天的食物太少，我有点动心。
lines.en: Winter food is scarce, so I am tempted.

lines.zh: 你晃那根线，粉色的我盯着看。
lines.en: You jiggle the line, and this pink fish watches.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，就一下。
lines.en: I bite once, just once.

lines.zh: 你太急了，鱼线绷得太紧。
lines.en: You are too eager; the line is pulled too tight.

lines.zh: 我把饵含在嘴里，没有吞下去。
lines.en: I hold the bait in my mouth without swallowing.

lines.zh: 冰洞里什么都少，除了你的耐心。
lines.en: There is little in this hole except your patience.

lines.zh: 我闻得出钩子的铁味。
lines.en: I can smell the iron of the hook.

lines.zh: 你换个位置，我跟过去了。
lines.en: You move elsewhere, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我馋，但我记得上次那条鱼的下场。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I recall what happened to the last fish.

lines.zh: 水面太亮，我只能靠味道找你。
lines.en: The surface is too bright; I find you by smell.

lines.zh: 你把饵放下就走了？我等一会儿再吃。
lines.en: You left the bait and went? I will eat it in a while.

lines.zh: 饵在冰洞口晃，我看了很久。
lines.en: The bait sways at the hole. I watch a long while.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，再碰一下。
lines.en: I circle it once, then nudge it.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩在冰上，冰裂的声音吓到我。
lines.en: Your boot cracks the ice and the sound frightens me.

lines.zh: 我被你凿下的冰碴砸了一下。
lines.en: A chip of ice you cut loose hits me.

lines.zh: 我撞在冰层下缘，粉鳍蹭白了。
lines.en: I hit the underside of the ice and scrape my fin white.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进水里，我撞开你的指节。
lines.en: Your hand enters the water and I butt your knuckles.

lines.zh: 我在你腿边游过，冷水被搅浑。
lines.en: I pass your legs and muddle the cold water.

lines.zh: 冰块撞过来，我贴着石头躲。
lines.en: A block of ice drifts in, and I duck behind a stone.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我身上滑得抓不住。
lines.en: You touch me, and I am too slick to hold.

lines.zh: 我撞开那根落水的树枝。
lines.en: I shove aside the branch that fell in.

lines.zh: 你的影子一压，我掉头就游。
lines.en: Your shadow presses down and I turn and swim.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我半天没缓过来。
lines.en: That knock leaves me stunned for a long while.

lines.zh: 另一条粉鳍游过来，我们并肩。
lines.en: Another pinkfin swims over and we go side by side.

lines.zh: 冷水里，只有我们的粉色。
lines.en: In the cold water, only our pink shows.

lines.zh: 她绕着我，鳍尖碰鳍尖。
lines.en: She circles me, fin tip touching fin tip.

lines.zh: 冰下最深处，我们停在那里。
lines.en: We come to rest in the deepest water under the ice.

lines.zh: 别往下看，这是我们的事。
lines.en: Do not look down there; this is between us.

lines.zh: 我把最暖的那处水让给她。
lines.en: I give her the warmest patch of water.

lines.zh: 两条鱼贴得很近，水流都缓了。
lines.en: Two fish press close, and even the current slows.

lines.zh: 河底的石头会记住这一季。
lines.en: The riverbed stones will remember this season.

lines.zh: 她的鳍比我的还粉。
lines.en: Her fins are pinker than mine.

lines.zh: 之后冰下会有更小的粉色游动。
lines.en: Later, smaller patches of pink will swim under the ice.

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶了顶那颗落水的浆果。
lines.en: I nudge the berry that fell into the water.

lines.zh: 一块冰碴，我推着玩了一会儿。
lines.en: A chip of ice; I push it around for a while.

lines.zh: 河底的螺壳，我试着叼起来。
lines.en: I try to lift a snail shell from the riverbed.

lines.zh: 太滑了，它又落回石头上。
lines.en: Too slippery; it drops back onto the stone.

lines.zh: 你掉进水里的东西，我守了一会儿。
lines.en: I guard the thing you dropped in for a while.

lines.zh: 我把一片枯叶拖到石缝里。
lines.en: I drag a dead leaf into a crevice.

lines.zh: 咬不住，冷水让我的嘴发僵。
lines.en: I cannot grip it; the cold stiffens my mouth.

lines.zh: 那根线在水里晃，我没去咬。
lines.en: The line sways in the water, and I leave it alone.

lines.zh: 我把小石子含着，游了几格。
lines.en: I hold a pebble in my mouth for a few blocks.

lines.zh: 最后还是吐了出来。
lines.en: At the end I spit it out.

lines.zh: 石缝里有个小东西在动。
lines.en: Something small is moving in the crevice.

lines.zh: 一条落水的小虫，我看见了。
lines.en: A bug that fell in the water; I see it.

lines.zh: 冰下有影子晃了一下。
lines.en: A shadow shifts beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 那株水草边有东西在爬。
lines.en: Something crawls by that clump of weed.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那点深色。
lines.en: I fix on that dark speck.

lines.zh: 它比我小，游得却急。
lines.en: It is smaller than me, yet it darts about.

lines.zh: 我朝石头的背面绕过去。
lines.en: I swing around behind the stone.

lines.zh: 冷让我慢，但眼睛没慢。
lines.en: The cold slows me, but not my eyes.

lines.zh: 我盯上它了，粉鳍向后压。
lines.en: I have my mark; my pink fin sweeps back.

lines.zh: 它一躲，我就知道它在哪。
lines.en: When it hides, I still know where it is.

lines.zh: 我贴近石底，尽量不出水声。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed and make as little noise as I can.

lines.zh: 它在动，我的鳍跟着摆。
lines.en: It moves, and my fins move with it.

lines.zh: 再近半寸，我就能咬到。
lines.en: Half an inch closer and I can bite.

lines.zh: 冰下的光太暗，我靠水流的感觉。
lines.en: Light is faint under the ice; I feel the current instead.

lines.zh: 它停住了，我也停。
lines.en: It stops, and I stop.

lines.zh: 粉鳍太亮，我躲到影子后面。
lines.en: My pink fin is too bright, so I hide in a shadow.

lines.zh: 我等它游出那块石头的遮挡。
lines.en: I wait for it to leave the stone's cover.

lines.zh: 它掉头往冰缝里钻，我追上去。
lines.en: It turns for the ice crack, and I give chase.

lines.zh: 我不擅长等，但冬天教会了我。
lines.en: Waiting is not my gift, but winter taught me.

lines.zh: 就差一点点，我快要咬到了。
lines.en: Only a hair short; my jaws almost close on it.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，冷水里多了点红。
lines.en: I bite down, and a little red enters the cold water.

lines.zh: 这一口很轻，我没多少力气。
lines.en: The bite is light; I have little strength.

lines.zh: 它挣扎，把我甩在石头上。
lines.en: It thrashes and throws me against the stone.

lines.zh: 我只好再咬一次。
lines.en: So I bite again.

lines.zh: 我的牙不适合撕，只适合叼。
lines.en: My teeth are not for tearing, only for holding.

lines.zh: 咬完我就沉到河底。
lines.en: After biting I sink to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 它跑了，我嘴里留着一片鳞。
lines.en: It escapes, leaving a single scale in my mouth.

lines.zh: 别以为粉色的就不咬人。
lines.en: Do not assume pink means harmless.

lines.zh: 我在它身上留了个小口子。
lines.en: I leave a small cut on it.

lines.zh: 打完我躲进冰影里喘。
lines.en: When it is over I hide in the ice's shadow to breathe.

lines.zh: 我在冻河的冰层下出现，水冷得扎人。
lines.en: I appear beneath the frozen river, in water that stings.

lines.zh: 第一次摆尾，粉鳍就在水里亮起来。
lines.en: My first tailbeat sets the pink of my fin glowing.

lines.zh: 我们两条一起，慢慢游进河心。
lines.en: The two of us drift slowly into the middle of the river.

lines.zh: 河岸都是雪，水是墨绿的。
lines.en: The banks are all snow, and the water is dark green.

lines.zh: 我生下来就耐冷，别问我为什么。
lines.en: I was born tolerant of cold; do not ask me why.

lines.zh: 一块浮冰从我头顶漂过。
lines.en: A slab of ice drifts over my head.

lines.zh: 这里鱼少，来的都是和我一样的。
lines.en: Few fish come here, and those that do are like me.

lines.zh: 冰洞的口子刚好够我游出去。
lines.en: The opening in the ice is just wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 冬天的河很静，连风都隔在冰外。
lines.en: The winter river is still, with even the wind kept outside.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的，就是白。
lines.en: The first thing I ever saw was white.

lines.zh: 火把伸进冰洞，热水烫得我直躲。
lines.en: A torch enters the hole, and the warmed water stings.

lines.zh: 我被冰水冲到下游的石滩上。
lines.en: The meltwater washes me onto a gravel bank downstream.

lines.zh: 我困在冰下，气越来越短。
lines.en: Trapped under the ice, my air runs shorter and shorter.

lines.zh: 冰被炸裂，冲击把我推了好远。
lines.en: The ice bursts and the shock throws me far.

lines.zh: 鱼叉穿过水，擦着我的鳍。
lines.en: A harpoon cuts through the water and grazes my fin.

lines.zh: 紫光让我整条鱼僵在冰水里。
lines.en: Violet light locks my whole body in the freezing water.

lines.zh: 冻河里的食被雪盖住，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: Snow has buried the river's food, and I am frantic with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在河面，冷水一阵发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river and the cold water tingles.

lines.zh: 河底的深潭把我往下吸。
lines.en: The deep pool at the riverbed pulls me under.
